title: Bark revenue falls despite commerce growth resuming in Q2
description:
Bark net revenue and direct-to-consumer (DTC) revenue both declined in the company’s fiscal second quarter ended Sept. 30. However, the seller of pet products managed to reignite growth for its commerce revenue — which comes from sales with retail partners — and prepare the sale of its dog-focused airline as it sought to correct course […]
